title: III: heaven produced in the beginning of time; angels
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): concerning that same which one must judge soberly out from Scripture, not out from Pseudo-Dionysius — orders plus hierarchies stand as distinguished. but where God has willed them to be — they stand as not everywhere by means belonging toward essence as God is. They stand as not eternal but created; complete, incorporeal, understanding, willing, powerful — angels stand as spiritual substances. plus with them ye Angels, intelligent spirits, created by means belonging toward God immediately — the heavens were produced in ye beginning belonging toward time. III.
pass_b_english: III. The heavens were produced in the beginning of time, and with them the Angels, intelligent spirits, created by God immediately.

Angels are spiritual substances, complete, incorporeal, understanding, willing, powerful. They are not eternal but created; they are not everywhere by essence as God is, but where God has willed them to be.
Orders and hierarchies are distinguished, concerning which one must judge soberly from Scripture, not from Pseudo-Dionysius.
source_text: III. Caeli in principio temporis producti sunt, et cum eis Angeli, spiritus intelligentes, a Deo immediate creati. Angeli sunt substantiae spirituales, completae, incorporeae, intelligentes, volentes, potentes. Non sunt aeterni, sed creati; non sunt ubique per essentiam ut Deus, sed ubi Deus eos esse voluerit. Distinguuntur ordines et hierarchiae, de quibus sobrie ex Scriptura, non ex Pseudodionysio, judicandum.
